lines.en: I drift along, my robe silent.
A block above the ground, I slide.
I drift out of the black cloud.
I pass the pillar without touching it.
I drift over your head, cold.
I move ahead; my aura leads.

lines.zh: 我的袖子垂着，一动不动。
lines.en: My sleeves hang perfectly still.
I float past, hugging the wall.
The ground darkens where I pass.
I never land, and need not.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有活气的地方去。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward anything alive.
I float as if carried by a handle.
I hang still, black mist around my sleeves.
I wait quietly to reap.
My sockets are empty.
I do not breathe, and have no heartbeat.
I tilt my head as if listening.
Black mist circles my feet.
I cast no shadow at all.
I hang there, weightless.
I stay still; the black cloud moves.

lines.zh: 我等下一个活着的东西。
lines.en: I wait for the next living thing.
I slowly turn my wrist over.

lines.zh: 我的袍角化成雾又凝回来。
lines.en: My hem turns to mist and hardens again.
My arms hang thin.
I lower my head for a long while.
No hurry; withering needs none.

lines.zh: 我浮在原处，像一页旧纸。
lines.en: I hang like an old page.
I watch you through black mist.
I tilt my head, interested.
I raise a hand, fingertips black.
You carry the light of the living.
I come a little closer.
There is nothing in my eyes.
I stare at your breathing.
I stop beside you.
I borrow your shadow.
I laugh, softly.
My cuff opens toward you.
I know you will not last long.
I nod very slowly.

lines.zh: 你在看我的脸，我在看你的命。
lines.en: You look at my face; I look at your life.
My mist scatters.
I drift back half a block.
The hit spot turns to smoke.
I make a soft sound.
A corner of my cuff is torn.

lines.zh: 我稳住身形，重新凝起来。
lines.en: I steady myself and reform.
I have no blood to spill.
My body thins by a layer.
My form scatters, then gathers again.
My sockets darken.
I glance at it without interest.
I cannot eat these.

lines.zh: 我把你递来的东西拨开。
lines.en: I push away what you offer.

lines.zh: 这些东西填不满我的空壳。
lines.en: These things can't fill my hollow shell.
I sniff and smell nothing.

lines.zh: 我抬手让那东西浮起来。
lines.en: I lift it with a gesture.
It blackens in my hand.
I would rather feed on your ki.
I push it back to you with black mist.
I stare at you, not at it.

lines.zh: 你撞进黑雾里，闷了一下。
lines.en: You hit the black mist and it muffles you.
My robe parts and closes again.
A chill runs through you as you pass.

lines.zh: 我的袖口蹭过你的额头。
lines.en: My cuff brushes across your brow.
The impact drifts me half a block.
You cough; the air tastes bitter.
Black smoke rises between us.
My black mist clings to you.

lines.zh: 你从我的袍子里穿过去。
lines.en: You pass straight through my robes.
You pull back; I stay put.
Two clouds of black mist draw together.
Our robes overlap into one.
We trade a mouthful of black mist.
I reach; it reaches too.
We hang together, silent.
Its hand passes through mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起转向同一个活物。
lines.en: We turn to the same living thing.
Our mists merge.
Neither of us breathes.

lines.zh: 我们静静地听同一个声音。
lines.en: We listen to the same sound in silence.
I raise a hand and it floats up.
I hold it up with black mist.
I let the thing sink into my sleeve.
I hold it and study it.
It darkens slowly in my hand.
I drop it into the mist.
I lift it to my empty socket.
I have no weight, and neither does it.
I make it circle me.
I crumble it into smoke.
I stop and turn that way.
I smell living breath.
My mist flows that way.
I begin to sink.
The withering has gathered enough.
I raise both hands.
Your life force stands out.
I will not stand here waiting.
I lower my black mist and slide toward you.
My cuffs point at you.
I laugh, without sound.

lines.zh: 你的气息已经被我收好。
lines.en: I've tucked your breath away.
I drift after you, very lightly.
You run; I do not speed up.
My mist closes in bit by bit.
You look back and cannot see me.
I float at your back.

lines.zh: 我的手在你肩上方悬着。
lines.en: My hand hangs over your shoulder.
Did you hear the rustle of cloth?
I go around the tree and follow.

lines.zh: 我的雾留在你的脚印上。
lines.en: My mist settles on your footprints.
You are behind a door; I am outside it.
I hang outside the window, waiting.
You step back; I advance half a block.
I stay one block above you.

lines.zh: 我的指骨陷进你的肩窝。
lines.en: My finger bones sink into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抬手，黑气扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the black mist hits your face.

lines.zh: 我的袖子扫过，你在发冷。
lines.en: My sleeve sweeps by and you go cold.
My fingertip touches your chest.

lines.zh: 我把凋零灌进你的伤口。
lines.en: I pour withering into your wound.
My hand rakes down, cold.
My mist pushes you once.
My blow is light, but it lingers.
My nails rake your face.
You pull back; the mist stays on you.
Black cloud rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 一个细长的影子出现了。
lines.en: A thin shadow appears.
The air turns faintly bitter.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪柱的黑气里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the spawner's black haze.

lines.zh: 这里多了一缕不散的烟。
lines.en: A wisp of smoke that will not disperse.
You hear someone chuckle.

lines.zh: 我的袖子先从黑里垂下来。
lines.en: My sleeve hangs out of the dark first.
The torchlight shrinks.
I slowly gather into a shape.
This ground begins to wither.

lines.zh: 我在你背后两格处成形。
lines.en: I form two blocks behind you.
The daylight seems blocked by something.

lines.zh: 黑气绕着地面转了一圈。
lines.en: Black mist circles the ground once.
I hang before you, weightless.
Fire burns a hole through my mist.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，散成一片烟。
lines.en: I fall from above and scatter into smoke.

lines.zh: 水把我和黑气一起压住。
lines.en: Water presses me down with the mist.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的形体吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows my form apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，带出一道黑烟。
lines.en: An arrow runs me through, trailing black smoke.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的雾定住了。
lines.en: That force pins my mist in place.

lines.zh: 没有活气可吸，我在变淡。
lines.en: With nothing to drain, I fade.

lines.zh: 雷劈进我的雾里，白了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning enters my mist and flares white.

lines.zh: 下面空了，我的烟被吸下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my smoke is pulled down.
